card.name: Season and year words ending a time phrase
card.fires_on: Time-period nouns such as season, year, spring or weekend in general web text, often right after a modifier like grilling, school, election or early. It also fires on small words just before such a season phrase.

modes.label: Season or year noun
modes.description: A calendar-period noun completes a phrase like grilling season or school year.
modes.example: Keep friends, family and yourself safe during grilling<< season>> by following these food safe tips.

modes.label: Word before a season
modes.description: A linking word or possessive comes right before a season phrase.
modes.example: February in Barrow is the time for the Inupiat to begin preparations for<< their>> spring whaling season.

modes.label: Journal name word
modes.description: A word inside a journal title or citation code, outside the time theme.
modes.example: Annals of the American<< Academy>> of Political and Social Science 62
